name: pomodoro-timer
title: Pomodoro Timer
description: Pomodoro timer on a shadcn Card with Tabs and Buttons: a ring drains as time passes, digits roll, Play morphs into Pause, and a tomato squishes and sparkles when time's up. Runs 60× faster in the demo. Hover: the ring glows and the tomato wobbles. Disabled: controls disabled, ring greyed.
